At a comparable point before those elections, Civiqs polling showed Trump on 43 percent approval and 53 percent disapproval, for a net approval rating of -10. His current net rating of -23 leaves him 13 points worse off nationally than he was ahead of his first midterm election.

Donald Trump in the Oval Office of the White House on July 21, 2026 in Washington, DC.

## What the Demographic Data Shows
